extension.description: Export Markdown to a real, editable .docx — Mermaid diagrams become native Word shapes, not flattened images.
command.exportDocument.title: md2nativedocx: Export document to Word
command.exportBlock.title: md2nativedocx: Export diagram under cursor
configuration.outputDirectory.markdownDe: Output folder for generated `.docx` files. Empty (default) = same folder as the source `.md` file — no configuration required before first use.
configuration.referenceDocument.markdown: Path to a `.docx` file used as the Word template for every export (mirrors Pandoc's `--reference-doc`) — point this at your company's template to match its fonts, colors, and styles. Empty (default) = the extension's built-in template. Relative paths are resolved against the workspace folder.
configuration.smartArt.enabled.markdownD: Off by default (a 2026-09-03 real-Word test found a diagram it produced would not open at all — see the compliance notes). When on, an eligible diagram (a simple chain, tree, or cycle shape) becomes a native, editable SmartArt graphic instead of the usual OOXML canvas shapes; treat as experimental until verified reliable in Word.
configuration.layout.pageSize.markdownDe: Page format for the generated document. Ignored (with a note in the export log) when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` points at a custom template — its own page setup is used instead.
configuration.layout.orientation.markdow: Default page orientation. Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set, same as page format above.
configuration.layout.margins.markdownDes: Page margins preset, or `custom` to use the four `md2nativedocx.layout.marginsCustom*` values below (in centimeters). Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.layout.margins.custom: Custom — use the four marginsCustom* settings below.
configuration.layout.marginsCustomTop.ma: Top margin in centimeters. Only used when `#md2nativedocx.layout.margins#` is `custom`.
Right margin in centimeters. Only used when `#md2nativedocx.layout.margins#` is `custom`.
configuration.layout.marginsCustomBottom: Bottom margin in centimeters. Only used when `#md2nativedocx.layout.margins#` is `custom`.
configuration.layout.marginsCustomLeft.m: Left margin in centimeters. Only used when `#md2nativedocx.layout.margins#` is `custom`.
configuration.typography.headingFont.mar: Font family for headings/titles. Empty (default) = the built-in template's own heading font (Aptos Display). Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.typography.bodyFont.markdo: Font family for body text. Empty (default) = the built-in template's own body font (Aptos). Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.typography.fontSize.markdo: Base font size, in points, for body text. Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.typography.lineSpacing.mar: Default paragraph line spacing. `default` (recommended) keeps the built-in template's own 1.08 spacing (Word's current default) untouched. Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.typography.lineSpacing.def: Default — keep the built-in template's own spacing (1.08) untouched.
configuration.typography.justify.markdow: Default paragraph justification. `left` matches Word's own default. Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.typography.accentColor.mar: Theme accent color as a 6-digit hex value, no `#` (e.g. `2E7D32`). Empty (default) = the built-in template's own accent color. Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.layout.footerPageNumber.ma: Add a footer with a centered page number. Ignored when `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` is set.
configuration.toc.enabled.markdownDescri: Insert an automatic table of contents after the document's title. Word shows it empty until fields are refreshed on first open — this setting also flips that refresh-on-open behavior, so a real Word (unlike some other viewers) fills it in automatically. Works with `#md2nativedocx.referenceDocument#` too.
configuration.toc.depth.markdownDescript: How many heading levels (H1-H4) the table of contents includes. Only used when `#md2nativedocx.toc.enabled#` is on.
configuration.emoji.forceColorFont.markd: Force the "Segoe UI Emoji" font on ✅/⚠️/❌ and other pictographic characters so Word renders them in color instead of falling back to a flat grey glyph. Depends on local font substitution on macOS/Linux/LibreOffice — turn this off if it renders worse there than doing nothing.
walkthrough.title: md2nativedocx — Mermaid diagrams to Word
walkthrough.description: Export your Mermaid diagrams as native, editable Word shapes — not flattened PNG images.
walkthrough.step1.title: Open a Markdown document
walkthrough.step1.description: Open or create a `.md` file containing a ` ```mermaid ` block.
walkthrough.step2.title: Click "⚙️ Export to Word"
walkthrough.step2.description: A link automatically appears above every detected mermaid block — no command to remember.
walkthrough.step3.title: Get your `.docx`
walkthrough.step3.description: A notification offers to open the file in Word or reveal it in the file explorer — shapes are individually selectable and editable.
